pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Auphonic is free for 2 hours of monthly processed audio… S: $11/month for 9 hours; M: $23/month for 21 hours; L: $45/month for 45 hours; XL: $89/month for 100 hours. Yearly plans save 20%."

plans.name: Free
plans.quota: 2 hours of processed audio per month

nl.tagline: Automatische audio-nabewerking: niveaus, ruis en loudness
nl.description: Auphonic, een Oostenrijks bedrijf, bewerkt audio automatisch na: gelijkmatige volumes, ruisreductie, filtering en loudness volgens broadcast-normen. Het koppelt met podcastplatforms en heeft een API. Je betaalt per uur verwerkte audio.
bestFor: Automatische verwerking via API of workflows
notFor: Wie audio handmatig wil knippen en monteren
limitations: Gratis: 2 uur verwerkte audio per maand; ongebruikte credits vervallen

en.tagline: Automatic audio post-production: levels, noise and loudness
en.description: Auphonic, an Austrian company, automatically post-processes audio: balanced levels, noise reduction, filtering and loudness to broadcast standards. It integrates with podcast platforms and has an API. You pay per hour of processed audio.
bestFor: Automated processing via API or workflows
notFor: People who want to cut and edit audio manually
limitations: Free: 2 hours of processed audio per month; unused credits expire
